planets.name: HAT-P-36 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Tuiren with a 1.33-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: HAT-P-36 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Tuiren. Its orbit and size follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CHAKRABARTY__AMP__SENGUPTA_2019): disc_year 2011, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.327346813, pl_radj 1.277, pl_bmassj 1.8482

quotes.title: HAT-P-36
quotes.card: In December 2019, HAT-P-36 was named Tuiren and its planetary companion, HAT-P-36b, was named Bran as a result of Ireland's contribution to the 2019 NameExoWorlds campaign.
quotes.introduction: Bran has a mass approximately 1.8 times that of Jupiter and a radius 1.2 times larger.
